sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 144.11M and this page's prices come from the confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT (16:53 UTC). ⭐ IN THIS ROUND ALL FIVE BOOKS CONFIRMED, and the winner book is receiving a new price again after one round without. ⭐ AND THE NATIONAL POLLING DROUGHT ENDED ON THE THIRD DAY: Veritá released on 06/Sep a national poll with fieldwork from 01 to 04/Sep, registration BR-09426/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse). The register shows another ten national polls with releases scheduled between 07 and 11/Sep, among them Quaest, Nexus, AtlasIntel and Datafolha. There are 28 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).
sentimento.text2: ⭐ THE POLL AND THE PRICE MOVED IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS TODAY, and that crossing is what this page exists to record. Veritá puts Flávio Bolsonaro numerically ahead in the first round, 38.9% against 38.4% for Lula, a distance of 0.5 point inside a margin of 2 points. On the same day, the winner contract widened the gap: Lula 56.50% against 39.70%, or 16.80pp, against 15.35pp on the confirmed reading of 04/Sep. They are different quantities, declared voting intention and traded probability of winning, and they do not subtract from one another. The AFOS records that the two rank the race in opposite ways, without saying which one is right.
sentimento.text3: ⚠️ AND THE BOOK THAT MOVED MOST WAS THE THIRD-PLACE ONE. Augusto Cury rose 4.25pp to 56.20%, and Renan Santos rose 1.50pp to 26.00%. 📌 Cury's name rises in both universes at once: Veritá measures him at 12.2%, against 2.2% in the same house's round of 21/Aug. In the first-round runner-up contract, Lula rose 2.55pp to 7.90%, while Flávio stayed put at 89.50%. In the Senate majority contract, the MDB gave up 0.40pp to 10.35%.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 39.70% (vol USD 9.74M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT (16:53 UTC), a fall of 0.45pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Sep. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he is still at 89.50% (vol USD 612 thousand), unchanged. ⭐ The most recent poll is Veritá of 06/Sep, fieldwork from 01 to 04/Sep, which puts him at 38.9% in the first round, ahead of Lula by 0.5 point and inside the margin of 2 points. It is the second national poll of the window to place him numerically ahead, after Gerp of 26/Aug.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 56.50% (vol USD 9.83M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT (16:53 UTC), a rise of 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Sep. ⚠️ In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he rose 2.55pp to 7.90% (vol USD 474 thousand). Veritá of 06/Sep measures him at 38.4% in the first round, behind Flávio Bolsonaro by 0.5 point, in a survey with no [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) scenario. The most recent runoff reading is still Datafolha of 03/Sep, which has him beating the four pairings it tested.
sentimento.terceiraVia: ⭐ Augusto Cury is the name that rose most in both universes. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract he rose 4.25pp to 56.20% (vol USD 126 thousand), confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT (16:53 UTC), after two consecutive falls. And Veritá of 06/Sep measures him at 12.2% in the first round, against 2.2% in the same house's round of 21/Aug. In the winner contract, however, he gave up 0.80pp to 1.15% (vol USD 4.16M): the market sees him in the leading pack of the first round and not as a candidate to win the election.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT (16:53 UTC), across the five books this page follows: winner, [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up, first-round third place, [Supreme Court](/en/glossary#stf) impeachment and Senate majority. The AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20 point, and the confirmation is made contract by contract. In this round all five books confirmed. ⚠️ Still without a new price are the names below 0.5% in the winner contract, which are Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Pablo Marçal, Jair Bolsonaro, Michelle Bolsonaro, Tarcisio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad.

inss.text1: 📌 THERE IS NO NEW INSS ACT ON 05/Sep. The ceremony at the Planalto Palace, the change of criterion and the figures that came with it are all from 03/Sep, and the page keeps them with their original date. What came out on 05/Sep on the subject is analysis, not new fact.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT FALLS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A NUMBER, AND IT IS FROM 03/Sep. Claims delayed by more than 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million in January, a fall of 86%. Open claims fell to 1.2 million. Folha de S.Paulo reported on 03/Sep that the government changed the criterion for declaring the queue cleared, and O Globo reported the same day that the announcement sits alongside more than 200 thousand claims still awaiting a response.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the social security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing more claims per month than the number of new ones coming in. It is a throughput criterion, not a stock one, and the two measure different realities.
inss.text4: The case remains open and unresolved. The distinction the panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on the government's approval rating is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another, and the two do not add up.
inss.impactoLula: The structured government-assessment reading is still the Genial/[Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) one of 02/Sep, with field from 30/Aug to 01/Sep: 45% approve and 48% disapprove, with 7% giving no answer. Datafolha of 03/Sep brings a more recent reading, with 45% approval and 51% disapproval, and the panel keeps one house per block so as not to break the internal series. No new poll came in today.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the picture is one of stasis. On 05/Aug it was 48% approval against 47% disapproval, on 14/Aug 46% against 48% and on 02/Sep 45% against 48%. Disapproval repeats the same figure for the third round running. With no new poll today, that picture has not moved.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is narrow and worth recording as such: nothing changed. There was no new INSS act on 05/Sep and no new government approval poll, for the second day running. The structured reading is still the Genial/Quaest poll of 02/Sep, and Datafolha of 03/Sep is the most recent available. The panel does not attribute price movement to this subject, because there is no new fact from it in this window.

bancoMaster.text1: 📌 THERE IS NO NEW ACT IN THE CASE ON 05/Sep, AND THE CHRONOLOGY OF 04/Sep IS STILL THE INFORMATION. On 04/Sep the Prosecutor-General's Office ordered an inquiry into whether there was interference in the production of the Federal Police report that revealed the Banco Master owner's messages to Alexandre de Moraes, and asked Edson Fachin for authorisation to investigate André Mendonça over that suspicion, according to Estadão, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo. On the same 04/Sep the court's president had already removed the investigation request from the fake news inquiry.
bancoMaster.text2: The Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council opened a procedure to examine the mentions of Paulo Gonet in Daniel Vorcaro's messages, according to Estadão and Valor Econômico, and it is the council the prosecutor-general himself chairs. A wing of the [Supreme Court](/en/glossary#stf) argues he should step aside from the case, according to O Globo, and the request that he step aside was also made by a member of Congress, according to SBT News.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ AND THERE ARE TWO PLEA-BARGAIN FRONTS UNDER WAY, WITH DIFFERENT DATES. The plea bargain of the owner of Entre Investimentos, who made payments to the fund that would have financed Dark Horse, was closed by the prosecutor-general's office and sent to the Supreme Court, according to Folha de S.Paulo and G1. And in a REJECTED plea-bargain proposal, from 03/Sep, Daniel Vorcaro said the donation to Jair Bolsonaro and to Tarcisio de Freitas was a bribe arranged by Gilberto Kassab, according to Folha de S.Paulo. Tarcisio de Freitas called the claim an inference bordering on the ridiculous, according to O Globo.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The chronology is still the information, and the two dates it gained are both from 04/Sep: the court's president removed the investigation request from the fake news inquiry, and the Prosecutor-General's Office ordered an inquiry into the Federal Police report, asking for authorisation to investigate the justice who commissioned it. 📌 The meeting between the justice and the businessman is from 14 March 2025, the messages are from 16 November 2025 and the businessman's arrest is from 17 November 2025. None of those dates is 05/Sep, and the page keeps them with their original date.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act on 05/Sep. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, alongside Alexandre de Moraes.
stf.moraes: ⚠️ THE FEDERAL POLICE REPORT HE USED REMAINS UNDER AN INQUIRY OPENED ON 04/Sep by the Prosecutor General's Office, which ordered an investigation into whether there was interference in the production of the document, according to Folha de S.Paulo, Gazeta do Povo and Estadão. No new individual act on 05 or 06/Sep.
stf.gilmar: ⭐ ON 05/Sep HE FILED A PROPOSED AMENDMENT TO THE COURT'S INTERNAL RULES, presented to president Edson Fachin, to bar the appointment of military and police officers, even those on leave or seconded, to commissioned posts in the justices' offices, according to Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo, Estadão, Valor Econômico and Gazeta do Povo.
stf.dino: No new individual act on 05/Sep. His statement that the [Supreme Court](/en/glossary#stf) is bigger than anyone who sits on it is from 04/Sep, and the page keeps it with its original date.
stf.mendonca: ⚠️ THE PROSECUTOR'S OFFICE ASKED FOR CLEARANCE TO INVESTIGATE HIM ON 04/Sep. Paulo Gonet asked Edson Fachin for authorisation to look into the suspicion that he interfered with the Federal Police, in the report on the messages, according to Estadão, O Globo and Gazeta do Povo. No new individual act on 05 or 06/Sep.
stf.nexo: ⭐ THE CASE PRODUCED TWO NEW ACTS ON 05/Sep, AND NEITHER CAME FROM THE TWO JUSTICES AT THE CENTRE OF THE CRISIS. Gilmar Mendes filed a proposed amendment to the internal rules to remove police and military officers from the justices' offices, presented to Edson Fachin. And Cristiano Zanin went to the [Supreme Court](/en/glossary#stf), the Superior Electoral Court and the Paraná Court of Justice after Deltan Dallagnol attached his tax secrecy data to a candidacy registration, asking that those responsible be held to account, according to Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo, Estadão and Valor Econômico. 📌 Edson Fachin signalled on 05/Sep an intention to take the crisis to the full bench, and that decision has not yet been taken. On 06/Sep, a Sunday, there is no new institutional act.
stf.analise: 8.60% (vol USD 88 thousand) in the contract on a [Supreme Court](/en/glossary#stf) justice leaving by impeachment before 2027, confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT (16:53 UTC), all but unchanged against the 8.65% of the day before. 📌 The contrast with the news is the record of the day: on 05/Sep the case produced two new institutional acts, a proposed amendment to the internal rules and a request for accountability over a breach of tax secrecy, and the price did not move. In the series recorded since 14/Apr the high is 19.30%, set on 04/Sep, and the low is 2.10%, from 08/Jun, so today's price sits 10.60pp below a high from two days ago, in a book that has accumulated USD 88 thousand.
